text:
evan: Heads-up 1: spotted several visual issues in the dark Console heatmap during the PM review. Main items: legend swatches too low-contrast, inline code blocks look "flat", chart tooltips feel ghosted. Screenshot: (attached).
anya: Thanks. Can you list the exact swatches that look wrong?
evan: The lowest two bins (0-3%, 4-9%) basically blend into the bg at 100% zoom. Legend text "low/med/high" also confuses PMs.
sam: Figma check: our heatmap currently uses a linear blue ramp with stops [#071018 -> #124a6a -> #5bd0ff]. On dark backgrounds the first stop is nearly identical to the page bg. Two options: lift the darkest stop or add a faint inner stroke to swatches/cells.
joy: Accessibility reminder: small legends must hit 4.5:1. Also color-only encoding for tiny differences fails for many colorblind palettes. Recommend: numeric labels, 1px inner stroke on swatches, and a pattern overlay for the rarest bucket (dots/diagonal hatch) for exported assets.
design-bot: Auto-contrast-check: legend label #9aa8b6 on bg #071018 -> 4.0:1. Small text fails AA. Suggest #c2d3df or semi-bold weight.
anya: Copy proposal: replace "low/med/high" with explicit ranges: "Rare (0-5%)", "Occasional (6-20%)", "Common (21-60%)", "Frequent (>60%)". Also add short caption under exported images explaining mapping.
evan: For code blocks, current fg #c8d6e0 on bg #0b0f12 looks washed. Proposal: shift fg to #eaf6ff or warm the bg slightly to #0e1113 so contrast improves.
sam: Quick CSS prototype for hover/focus states:
```
:root{--code-bg:#0e1113;--code-fg:#eaf6ff}
.code-block{background:var(--code-bg);color:var(--code-fg)}
.heatmap .cell.low{box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.04)}
.heatmap .cell:focus{outline:3px solid #2563eb}
```
joy: Good. Also ensure keyboard focus is visible and aria-labels for each interactive cell (e.g., "Token X: 3% frequency"). For export: include <title> and <desc> in SVGs and alt text on PNGs.
anya: Two visual variants to prototype in Figma: (A) stronger darkest color + thin outline, (B) desaturated continuous ramp + pattern overlay on lowest bucket. I'll run a quick A/B with metrics.
esvan: Typo in my earlier note 1 1 disregard.
sam: Poll: outline (:+1:) or pattern (:-1:)?
design-bot: Result so far: outline 3, pattern 1.
joy: One more nit: tooltips should be nearly opaque on dark mode (opacity ~0.92) with a subtle 2px drop shadow so they don't read as translucent halos. Also tooltip text >=12px and semi-bold if contrast borderline.
anya: Great. Action items: Sam -> Figma variants & legend copy; Joy -> accessibility checklist & alt text examples; Evan -> screenshot with annotated failures. Target: include in next sprint grooming.
